external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Sodexo announces today a new five-year global partnership with Clariant, one of the world’s leading speciality chemical companies. The agreement includes a wide range of soft and hard FM services from cleaning, to building, grounds maintenance and technical support. The scope covers more than 50 sites in 13 countries across key markets in Europe, Americas and Asia Pacific.
